notes: Integer test vectors for the forecast late score (forecast-score/src/late_score.rs).
All values are fixed-point integers (temperature in 0.01 degC, pressure in Pa). Skill is in millionths.
skill = 0 if copied or reference == 0, else max(0, 1000000 - floor(1000000 * err / reference)); err = |forecast - truth|.
copied = mean24 if |forecast - mean24| <= tolerance, else last if |forecast - last| <= tolerance, else null.

Baselines: spread = isqrt(floor((n*sum(x^2) - sum(x)^2) / n^2)); persistence = isqrt(floor(sum((x[i+lag]-x[i])^2) / (n-lag))), lag 0 means 1, none when n <= lag; reference = persistence if persistence < spread else spread; mean24 = floor(sum/n) toward negative infinity.
Window hash = SHA3-256(ascii 'wrfcoin.forecast_late_score.window.v1' || u32_be(n) || per reading i64_be(timestamp) || i64_be(value)); readings are [timestamp, value].
Some integers exceed 2^53: parse and compute with big integers in JavaScript (1000000 * err does too).
A case has exactly one of expect / expect_error. Expected values were produced by an independent big-integer implementation.
